package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	t := time.Date(2026, time.July, 9, 16, 45, 30, 0, time.UTC)
	fmt.Println(t)
	fmt.Println(t.Year(), t.Month(), t.Day())
	fmt.Println(t.Hour(), t.Minute(), t.Second())
	fmt.Println(t.Weekday(), "is day", t.YearDay(), "of the year")

	later := time.Date(2026, time.July, 40, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	fmt.Println(later.Format(time.DateOnly))
}

durations.go.src:
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	d := 90 * time.Second
	fmt.Println(d)
	fmt.Println(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	fmt.Println(2*time.Hour + 15*time.Minute)
	fmt.Println(d.Seconds(), d.Minutes())
	fmt.Println(int64(d))

	start := time.Date(2026, time.July, 9, 16, 45, 30, 0, time.UTC)
	due := start.Add(36 * time.Hour)
	fmt.Println(due.Format("Mon 15:04"))
	fmt.Println(due.Sub(start))
	fmt.Println(start.AddDate(0, 1, 0).Format(time.DateOnly))
}

package main

)

func main() {
	t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02 15:04", "2026-07-09 16:45")
	fmt.Println(t, err)

	_, err = time.Parse("2006-01-02", "07/11/2026")
	fmt.Println(err)

	_, err = time.Parse("2006-01-02", "2026-02-30")
	fmt.Println(err)

	d, err := time.Parse("02/01/2006", "07/11/2026")
	fmt.Println(d.Format("2 January 2006"), err)
}

v2.go.src:
package main

import (
	jsonv1 "encoding/json"
	jsonv2 "encoding/json/v2"
	"fmt"
)

type Box struct {
	Label string   `json:"label"`
	Tags  []string `json:"tags"`
}

func main() {
	in := []byte(`{"LABEL": "tea"}`)
	var a, b Box
	fmt.Println(jsonv1.Unmarshal(in, &a), jsonv2.Unmarshal(in, &b))
	fmt.Printf("v1 label: %q\n", a.Label)
	fmt.Printf("v2 label: %q\n", b.Label)

	out1, _ := jsonv1.Marshal(Box{Label: "cake"})
	out2, _ := jsonv2.Marshal(Box{Label: "cake"})
	fmt.Println("v1:", string(out1))
	fmt.Println("v2:", string(out2))

	dup := []byte(`{"label": "a", "label": "b"}`)
	fmt.Println("v1 error:", jsonv1.Unmarshal(dup, &a))
	fmt.Println("v2 error:", jsonv2.Unmarshal(dup, &b))
}

zones.go.src:
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	t := time.Date(2026, time.July, 9, 16, 45, 30, 0, time.UTC)
	tokyo, err := time.LoadLocation("Asia/Tokyo")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	lima := time.FixedZone("Lima", -5*60*60)

	fmt.Println("UTC:  ", t)
	fmt.Println("Tokyo:", t.In(tokyo))
	fmt.Println("Lima: ", t.In(lima))
	fmt.Println("same moment?", t.Equal(t.In(tokyo)))
	fmt.Println("== says:", t == t.In(tokyo))

	_, err = time.LoadLocation("Mars/Olympus")
	fmt.Println(err)
}
